Title: New Premium plans for Microsoft Azure RemoteApp and incentives for existing RDS CAL owners

Body.Content: Microsoft Azure RemoteApp now includes two new pricing plans. Premium and Premium Plus are for customers requiring more computing resources for their Windows apps hosted in Azure RemoteApp. Both plans include a five-user minimum. Customers who have Microsoft Enterprise Mobility Suite licenses or existing Remote Data Services (RDS) client access licenses (CALs) with Software Assurance might be eligible to purchase RemoteApp at as much as an 80-percent discount per user per month. For more information, visit the RemoteApp page, and for more information about pricing, visit the RemoteApp Pricing page.
